coordinate_contract.annotation_version: SGD R64-5-1 (2026-01-23) documented but not used for coordinates or V1 aggregation
coordinate_contract.callable_region: not_available; coverage and assembly length are reported separately and never called callable_bp
coordinate_contract.chromosome_naming: Peter matrices use chromosomes 1-16; mitochondrial chromosome 17 is excluded from GWAS autosomal summaries
coordinate_contract.gene_region_definition: not_used in V1 because full VCF and a validated coordinate annotation were not both cached
coordinate_contract.heterozygous_encoding: PLINK two-bit code 10; one unit in a 0/1/2 dosage numerator
coordinate_contract.homozygous_encoding: PLINK 00/11 according to source BIM allele order; Peter Table S8 supplies total homozygous SNP counts
coordinate_contract.low_quality_or_repeat_filter: inherited from Peter et al. pipeline; no additional filtering possible from the derived matrix
coordinate_contract.missing_genotype: PLINK two-bit code 01; excluded from called-marker denominator
coordinate_contract.multiallelic_handling: not_available in the high-MAF biallelic GWAS matrix; no reconstruction attempted
coordinate_contract.multiple_transcripts: not_applicable in V1; future rule proposed: union exons per SGD systematic gene

variant_definitions.snp: Peter Table S8 project SNP definition

coordinate_contract.vcf_reference_allele_direction: Peter population calls are aligned to S288C R64-1-1; raw VCF was not downloaded. PLINK numeric-allele summaries retain source coding and must not be interpreted as independently verified REF/ALT.

fallback_contract.proxy: proxy features with proxy_flag=true; excluded from all fit statistics

feature_valid_mask.semantics: dimension-level availability; public isolates have all dimensions, while the S288C proxy masks unavailable read/matrix fields

fit_contract.expression: seen_in_train AND mapping_type in {exact,supported} AND feature_valid
fit_contract.missing_value_fit: feature-wise median on eligible fit strains only
fit_contract.pca_role: auxiliary only; standardized interpretable features remain the primary artifact
fit_contract.standardization: feature-wise z-score, ddof=0, eligible fit strains only

genome_features.description: train-only median-imputed, z-scored biological V1 feature matrix; zero-variance columns and every invalid entity-feature cell are forced to zero

identity_fields.external_assembly_id: reference assembly accession for the S288C proxy; empty for Peter isolates in this V1
identity_fields.external_isolate_id: public biological isolate name (SX3, BJ6, JCM_2985-4B, UCD_09-448, FIMA_3, or S288C)
identity_fields.external_matrix_id: Peter matrix row/column ID for the five public isolates; empty for DHY210 proxy

raw_features.description: all biological and technical/QC source summaries before main-feature selection

s288c_invalid_dependency_groups.copy_number: S288C is not a row in the Peter copy-number matrix; called denominator unavailable
s288c_invalid_dependency_groups.frameshift: S288C is not a column in the Peter frameshift matrix; called denominator unavailable
s288c_invalid_dependency_groups.gwas: S288C is not a sample in the Peter PLINK fam; called denominator unavailable
s288c_invalid_dependency_groups.pangenome: S288C is not a row in the Peter pangenome matrices; called denominator unavailable
s288c_invalid_dependency_groups.ploidy: No frozen authority was acquired for the specific S288C proxy culture used by this task

s288c_valid_feature_sources.assembly_contig_count: NCBI GCF_000146045.2 assembly R64; 16 nuclear chromosomes plus mitochondrion
s288c_valid_feature_sources.assembly_max_contig_bp: NCBI GCF_000146045.2 chromosome IV NC_001136.10; 1,531,933 bp

technical_qc.description: retained for audit only and excluded from genome_features, scaler and PCA

unavailable_feature_groups: per-gene SNP/indel burden normalized by callable gene length

variant_interface.permutation_semantics: target row index to source row index
